subject: expn
title: (R)EXPN.------CULT.AF.B.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 385 (JR-7). EXPN is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) is the partner. From the subject: AFL (affinity alignment), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From AFL: TR-INFO (trans-information). From TR-INFO: IST-F (isolated focus). From PROG-CONT: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: INFO-DY, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From VT-DY: AF-NT (affinity nature). From AF-NT: AFI (affinity insight). The label STY (style) stands below the chart with no line or dot.
